name: Jobs
overview: Scripture reveals that our work is ordained and blessed by God, who desires to establish the efforts of our hands for His glory. Diligence in our labor is honored and can elevate a man to positions of influence, reflecting the value God places on faithful stewardship. Moreover, finding joy and satisfaction in one's work is a gift from God, who plans peace and an expected good outcome for His people. These truths encourage believers to approach their jobs with diligence, trust in God's sovereign purpose, and a heart that delights in the work He provides.
